name: blipr-extension
description: Watch any page, get a blip — a browser extension that pings your phone when an element appears or disappears.

scripts.package: node build.mjs && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../blipr-chrome.zip . && cd ../firefox && zip -qr ../blipr-firefox.zip .
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/blipr-source.zip && zip -qr dist/blipr-source.zip . -x 'node_modules/*' 'dist/*' '.git' '.git/*' 'web-ext-artifacts/*' '*.zip' '*/.DS_Store' '.DS_Store'
